create_laser2_model: create a laser2 model using a Laser2Config to instantiate a LaserLstmEncoder with embedding and LSTM parameters
build_laser2_encoder: build a LaserLstmEncoder model configured with vocabulary size, embedding dimension, hidden size, and number of layers
configure_laser2_model: configure a laser2 model with bidirectional LSTM, padding index, and padding value from Laser2Config

review_laser2_factory: review the _create_laser2_model function that constructs a LaserLstmEncoder from Laser2Config parameters
